from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import TimestampType, DoubleType
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
import pandas_market_calendars as mcal
import nltk

# =========================
# CONFIG
# =========================

TWEET_SILVER_PATH = (
    "abfss://silver@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets/historical/"
)

STOCK_SILVER_PATH = (
    "abfss://silver@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "stock/"
)

HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH = (
    "abfss://gold@stnvdaanna2026.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical/"
)

PREDICTION_CUTOFF_HOUR_ET = 6

print("Config loaded.")

tweets = spark.read.parquet(TWEET_SILVER_PATH)
stocks = spark.read.parquet(STOCK_SILVER_PATH)

print("Historical Tweet Silver:", tweets.count())
print("Stock Silver:", stocks.count())

tweets.select(
    F.min("tweet_created_at_date").alias("tweet_min_date"),
    F.max("tweet_created_at_date").alias("tweet_max_date")
).show()

stocks.select(
    F.min("Date").alias("stock_min_date"),
    F.max("Date").alias("stock_max_date")
).show()

nyse = mcal.get_calendar("NYSE")

tweet_date_bounds = (
    tweets_session
    .select(
        F.min("tweet_date_et").alias("min_date"),
        F.max("tweet_date_et").alias("max_date")
    )
    .first()
)

calendar_start = (
    pd.Timestamp(tweet_date_bounds["min_date"])
    - pd.Timedelta(days=14)
).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

calendar_end = (
    pd.Timestamp(tweet_date_bounds["max_date"])
    + pd.Timedelta(days=30)
).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

print("Calendar:", calendar_start, "→", calendar_end)

schedule = nyse.schedule(
    start_date=calendar_start,
    end_date=calendar_end
)

calendar_pdf = (
    schedule
    .reset_index()[["index"]]
    .rename(columns={"index": "trading_date"})
)

calendar_pdf["trading_date"] = (
    pd.to_datetime(calendar_pdf["trading_date"])
    .dt.date
)

trading_calendar = spark.createDataFrame(calendar_pdf)

print(
    "Trading calendar rows:",
    trading_calendar.count()

tweets_candidate = (
    tweets_session

    .withColumn(
        "candidate_session_date",

        F.when(
            F.hour("tweet_timestamp_et")
            < PREDICTION_CUTOFF_HOUR_ET,

            F.col("tweet_date_et")
        )

        .otherwise(
            F.date_add(
                F.col("tweet_date_et"),
                1
            )
        )
    )
)


session_mapping = (
    tweets_candidate.alias("t")

    .join(
        trading_calendar.alias("c"),

        F.col("c.trading_date")
        >=
        F.col("t.candidate_session_date"),

        "left"
    )

    .withColumn(
        "_session_rank",

        F.row_number().over(
            Window
            .partitionBy("tweet_id")
            .orderBy("trading_date")
        )
    )

    .filter(
        F.col("_session_rank") == 1
    )

    .drop("_session_rank")

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "trading_date",
        "prediction_session_date"
    )

session_mapping.agg(

    F.count("*").alias("rows"),

    F.countDistinct(
        "tweet_id"
    ).alias("distinct_tweets"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("prediction_session_date")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_sessions"),

    F.min(
        "prediction_session_date"
    ).alias("min_session"),

    F.max(
        "prediction_session_date"
    ).alias("max_session")

).show()


(
    session_mapping
    .groupBy("prediction_session_date")
    .count()
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
    .show(100, truncate=False)

tweet_features = (
    session_mapping

    # =========================
    # TEXT CLEANING
    # =========================

    .withColumn(
        "clean_text",

        F.trim(
            F.regexp_replace(
                F.regexp_replace(
                    F.col("full_text"),
                    r"http\S+|www\.\S+",
                    ""
                ),
                r"\s+",
                " "
            )
        )
    )

    # =========================
    # SENTIMENT
    # =========================

    .withColumn(
        "sentiment_score",
        vader_compound(
            F.col("clean_text")
        )
    )

    # =========================
    # ENGAGEMENT
    # =========================

    .withColumn(
        "interaction_score",

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("view_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        ) * 0.1

        +

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("retweet_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        ) * 2.0

        +

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("reply_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        ) * 1.5

        +

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("quote_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        ) * 1.2

        +

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("favorite_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "favorite_ratio",

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("favorite_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        )

        /

        (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("view_count").cast("double"),
                F.lit(0.0)
            )
            + 1.0
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "reply_ratio",

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("reply_count").cast("double"),
            F.lit(0.0)
        )

        /

        (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("retweet_count").cast("double"),
                F.lit(0.0)
            )
            + 1.0
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_viral",
        F.col("interaction_score") > 2000
    )

tweet_features = (
    tweet_features

    .withColumn(
        "account_created_timestamp",

        parse_twitter_timestamp(
            F.col("account_created_at")
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "account_created_date",

        F.to_date(
            "account_created_timestamp"
        )
    )

    # Point-in-time correct:
    # age at tweet date, NOT current_date()
    .withColumn(
        "account_age_days",

        F.datediff(
            F.col("tweet_date_et"),
            F.col("account_created_date")
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "credibility_score",

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("is_blue_verified")
            .cast("int"),
            F.lit(0)
        ) * 2.0

        +

        F.log1p(
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("followers_count")
                .cast("double"),
                F.lit(0.0)
            )
        )

        +

        (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("account_age_days")
                .cast("double"),
                F.lit(0.0)
            )
            / 365.0
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_new_account",

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("account_age_days"),
            F.lit(0)
        ) < 365
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_influencer",

        (
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("followers_count"),
                F.lit(0)
            ) > 130000
        )

        |

        F.coalesce(
            F.col("is_blue_verified"),
            F.lit(False)
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "day_of_week",

        F.date_format(
            F.col("prediction_session_date"),
            "EEEE"
        )
    )

    .withColumn(
        "is_weekend",

        F.dayofweek(
            F.col("tweet_date_et")
        ).isin([1, 7])
    )

tweet_features.agg(

    F.count("*")
    .alias("rows"),

    F.countDistinct("tweet_id")
    .alias("distinct_tweets"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("sentiment_score")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_sentiment"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("interaction_score")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_interaction"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("account_age_days")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_account_age"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("credibility_score")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_credibility")

).show()


tweet_features.select(

    F.min("sentiment_score")
    .alias("min_sentiment"),

    F.max("sentiment_score")
    .alias("max_sentiment"),

    F.min("account_age_days")
    .alias("min_account_age"),

    F.max("account_age_days")
    .alias("max_account_age"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("is_viral").cast("int")
    ).alias("viral_tweets"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("is_influencer").cast("int")
    ).alias("influencer_tweets")

).show()

stocks_clean = (
    stocks

    .withColumn(
        "stock_date",
        F.to_date(
            "Date",
            "yyyy-MM-dd"
        )
    )

    .select(
        "stock_date",

        F.col("Open")
        .cast("double")
        .alias("stock_open"),

        F.col("High")
        .cast("double")
        .alias("stock_high"),

        F.col("Low")
        .cast("double")
        .alias("stock_low"),

        F.col("Close")
        .cast("double")
        .alias("stock_close"),

        F.col("Volume")
        .cast("long")
        .alias("stock_volume")
    )
)


calendar_window = (
    Window.orderBy("trading_date")
)

trading_calendar_labeled = (
    trading_calendar

    .withColumn(
        "next_trading_date",

        F.lead(
            "trading_date"
        ).over(calendar_window)
    )

gold = (
    tweet_features.alias("t")

    .join(
        trading_calendar_labeled.alias("cal"),

        F.col("t.prediction_session_date")
        ==
        F.col("cal.trading_date"),

        "left"
    )

    .drop(
        F.col("cal.trading_date")
    )

gold = (
    gold.alias("g")

    .join(
        stocks_clean.alias("s"),

        F.col("g.prediction_session_date")
        ==
        F.col("s.stock_date"),

        "left"
    )

    .drop(
        F.col("s.stock_date")
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_open",
        "current_open"
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_high",
        "current_high"
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_low",
        "current_low"
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_close",
        "current_close"
    )

    .withColumnRenamed(
        "stock_volume",
        "current_volume"
    )

next_volume = (
    stocks_clean

    .select(
        F.col("stock_date")
        .alias("label_stock_date"),

        F.col("stock_volume")
        .alias("next_available_volume")
    )
)


gold = (
    gold.alias("g")

    .join(
        next_volume.alias("n"),

        F.col("g.next_trading_date")
        ==
        F.col("n.label_stock_date"),

        "left"
    )

    .drop("label_stock_date")

gold_final = (
    gold.select(

        # IDs
        F.col("tweet_id").cast("string").alias("tweet_id"),
        F.col("user_id").cast("string").alias("user_id"),

        # Time
        "tweet_created_at",
        "tweet_timestamp_utc",
        "tweet_timestamp_et",
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date",

        # Text
        "full_text",
        "clean_text",

        # Raw engagement
        F.col("view_count").cast("long").alias("view_count"),
        F.col("retweet_count").cast("long").alias("retweet_count"),
        F.col("reply_count").cast("long").alias("reply_count"),
        F.col("quote_count").cast("long").alias("quote_count"),
        F.col("favorite_count").cast("long").alias("favorite_count"),

        # Tweet features
        "sentiment_score",
        "interaction_score",
        "favorite_ratio",
        "reply_ratio",
        "is_viral",

        # User features
        "is_blue_verified",
        F.col("followers_count").cast("long").alias("followers_count"),
        F.col("friends_count").cast("long").alias("friends_count"),
        F.col("media_count").cast("long").alias("media_count"),

        "account_created_date",
        "account_age_days",
        "credibility_score",
        "is_new_account",
        "is_influencer",

        # Calendar
        "day_of_week",
        "is_weekend",

        # Market
        "current_open",
        "current_close",
        "current_high",
        "current_low",
        "current_volume",

        # ML target
        "next_available_volume"
    )

gold_final.agg(

    F.count("*")
    .alias("rows"),

    F.countDistinct("tweet_id")
    .alias("distinct_tweets"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("prediction_session_date")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_session"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("sentiment_score")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_sentiment"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("account_age_days")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_account_age"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("current_volume")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_current_volume"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("next_available_volume")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("null_next_volume"),

    F.min("prediction_session_date")
    .alias("min_session"),

    F.max("prediction_session_date")
    .alias("max_session")

).show()

(
    gold_final

    .groupBy(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )

    .agg(
        F.count("*")
        .alias("tweets"),

        F.first("current_volume")
        .alias("current_volume"),

        F.first("next_available_volume")
        .alias("next_available_volume"),

        F.avg("sentiment_score")
        .alias("avg_sentiment"),

        F.avg("interaction_score")
        .alias("avg_interaction")
    )

    .orderBy(
        "prediction_session_date"
    )

    .show(
        100,
        truncate=False
    )

training_ready = (
    gold_final
    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNotNull()
    )
)

print(
    "Gold rows:",
    gold_final.count()
)

print(
    "Training-ready rows:",
    training_ready.count()
)

print(
    "Training sessions:",
    training_ready
    .select("prediction_session_date")
    .distinct()
    .count()

invalid_labels = (
    gold_final

    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNotNull()
    )

    .filter(
        F.col("next_trading_date")
        <=
        F.col("prediction_session_date")
    )

    .count()
)

print(
    "Invalid future labels:",
    invalid_labels
)

assert invalid_labels == 0

(
    gold_final

    .write

    .mode("overwrite")

    .parquet(
        HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH
    )
)

print(
    "Historical Gold written to:",
    HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH

gold_check = spark.read.parquet(
    HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH
)

gold_check.agg(

    F.count("*")
    .alias("rows"),

    F.countDistinct("tweet_id")
    .alias("distinct_tweets"),

    F.countDistinct(
        "prediction_session_date"
    ).alias("sessions"),

    F.sum(
        F.col("next_available_volume")
        .isNull()
        .cast("int")
    ).alias("unlabeled_rows"),

    F.min(
        "prediction_session_date"
    ).alias("min_session"),

    F.max(
        "prediction_session_date"
    ).alias("max_session")

).show()


gold_check.printSchema()
